scorpion: Viper. Honest question. Do you ever take a day off?

viper: I took one, once.

scorpion: And?

viper: Somebody called. I came back.

scorpion: [laughs] Did you see that one fold? Like a lawn chair!

viper: I saw you reload in the open. Again.

scorpion: Details, boss. Details.

viper: Scorpion. How many shells have you got left?

scorpion: Enough.

viper: A number, please.

scorpion: Enough-ish.
When this is over, I am opening a bar. You can be my bouncer.

viper: I will be your accountant. Somebody has to stop you from drinking the stock.

scorpion: This farm used to grow potatoes, you know. Now look at it.

viper: It still grows something. Keep your eyes on the tree line.

scorpion: Boss, if I get turned down here, promise you shoot me before I get ugly.

viper: Too late for that.

scorpion: Hey!

viper: [laughs] Nobody gets turned. Stay close.
You talk to your shotgun.

scorpion: Betty listens. Unlike some people.

viper: Betty needs a cleaning if you keep dragging her through the mud.
Good work. Count your rounds.

scorpion: Counted them. Most of them went into heads.

viper: Most is the word that worries me.

scorpion: A whole village, and not one bakery open. Tragic.

viper: The bakers are out there in the fields, Scorpion. Do not ask them for bread.

scorpion: Raven, have you ever smiled? Like, once? As a baby?

raven: Once. It did not suit me.

scorpion: I bet it did.
[hums] Da da da, da da...
You know the song?

raven: No. That is why I want it to stop.

scorpion: Ha! I got more than you this time!

raven: You counted the ones you shot twice.

scorpion: They deserved it twice.

raven: Your dog. What is his name.

scorpion: Biscuit! Why?

raven: If you die, somebody has to feed him.

scorpion: Raven... that is almost sweet.
I think the cows here were the lucky ones. They left early.

raven: Nothing left this farm early. Look at the barn.

scorpion: Please tell me that is the wind.

raven: There is no wind down here.

scorpion: I hate you a little bit right now.
On a scale from one to ten, how much do you hate this job?

raven: Eleven. You are three of that.

scorpion: Raven, look, a piano. Can you play?
Seriously?

raven: Too many windows in these houses.

scorpion: Too many windows, not enough doors, and no beer. Worst village ever.

viper: You are quiet, Raven. Even for you.
And?
That was close on the left.
I know. I am saying it was close.

raven: Why do you always go in first?

viper: Because then I know who is behind me.
That is why I go.
Drink some water. That is not a request.
Your mother was right.

raven: These were not just labs. People lived down here.

viper: Then we remember them. And we keep moving.
The house holds if we hold it. The upstairs window is yours.
Because you never miss from up there.
With my life.
... Ask me tomorrow.
Clean sight lines down the street. Use them.

raven: I see the road. The fields worry me.

viper: Then you watch the fields. I have the road.

havoc: Scorpion! I like your shotgun! Can I put something extra in it?

scorpion: Touch Betty, and I put something extra in you.

havoc: [laughs] Oh, we are going to be friends!

scorpion: So. The metal leg. How did that happen?
Yours?

havoc: Mine! Best day of my life! Second best is today!
Did you see? Did you see that? Boom!

scorpion: I saw it. I am still picking it out of my hair.

viper: Havoc. One rule. You throw nothing without telling me first.

havoc: Telling you... before? That ruins the surprise!

viper: That is the point.

havoc: You are the boss type, huh? Plans, maps, all that.

viper: Plans keep people alive.

havoc: So do explosions! Just not the people nearby.
Raven, right? You look like you would be fun at parties!

raven: I do not go to parties.

havoc: I do! Mostly to blow them up.

scorpion: Ghost, buddy. Do you ever say more than three words at once?
That was one word.
How do you move that quietly?
Teach me?

ghost: You breathe too loud. Start there.

viper: Ghost. Your angle on the left, mine on the right.
Of course you are.
Coming from you, I will take it.

ghost: Do not tell Phantom I said that.

phantom: Do you always talk this much, or is tonight special?

scorpion: Always. You get used to it.
Nice jacket. Helix issue?

phantom: Tailored. Helix only paid for the holes.
You run a tidy team, Viper. I almost tried to recruit you once.

viper: Almost?

phantom: Your file said loyal. Terribly inconvenient.

viper: If you turn on us down here, Phantom...

phantom: You will be the first to know. I promise you that much.
You have been staring at the back of my head for ten minutes.
Charming. Do blink now and then.

havoc: Ghost! Ghost! Guess what I have got in my bag!

ghost: Something in your bag is ticking.

havoc: Oh. Oh! [laughs] That one is for later!
Phantom, admit it. You missed me.

phantom: Try not to blow up the doctor before she talks.
After, I will hold the lighter.
Ghost, say something nice about me.
Of course she did. She simply never knew how well.

viper: Drink, check your mags, and tell me if anything hurts.
Nobody does anything heroic without telling me first.
My first sergeant said quiet is a loan. You pay it back with interest.
Keep your spacing. One grenade should never get two of us.
We are doing fine. I want to keep saying that.
scorpion: I dreamt about tacos last night. Big ones. They talked.
If anybody asks, I was the hero of this whole thing.
My dog would have bitten half of these things by now. Good boy, Biscuit.
Betty is hungry. Betty is always hungry.
I miss my couch. I miss my couch so much.
[sighs] Zombies, gas, mad scientists. Next time I read the contract.
raven: I like the dark. They do not.
Count to ten. If it is still quiet, count again.
My knife is clean. The rest of me is not.
Do not get used to this. That is when they come.
Scorpion is quiet. Something is wrong.
phantom: In my day, the end of the world came with a dress code.
I do hope someone is keeping score. I am.
havoc: I named my grenades. This one is Gerald. Say hello, Gerald!
Is anybody else hungry? I could eat a horse. Or whatever that was.
ghost: I like this part. Nobody talks.

viper: That is the lot. Breathe, then move.
Good. Patch up while it lasts.
All clear. Nobody relax.
scorpion: And they say I cannot dance!
Clean-up on aisle everywhere!
Ha! Who is next? Anybody? No?
raven: That was all of them. This time.
